title: Cascadia Flare
summary: Cascadia Flare is an Arcane Enhancement for Secondary weapons, that grants increased secondary weapon damage for 10 seconds when applying  Heat status effect.
extract:
Cascadia Flare is an Arcane Enhancement for Secondary weapons, that grants increased secondary weapon damage for 10 seconds when applying  Heat status effect.

Effect

Acquisition
Cascadia Flare can be purchased from Cavalero for  5,500, requiring Rank 2 - Watcher with The Holdfasts. It can also be dropped by Thrax Centurion, Thrax Legatus, and Void Angels on the Zariman Ten Zero.
Dropped by Captain Vor in Tolstoj (Mercury) in The Steel Path.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Farming Tips
Thrax enemies are abundant in Mobile Defense and Void Cascade missions.
The Zariman Arcane drop is considered as a mod drop, and is thus affected by The Steel Path and Mod Drop Chance Booster.

Notes
At all ranks, it will take 40  Heat status effects to reach the maximum effect, which is 480% base damage bonus at Rank 5.
Only one stack can be added per damage instance; applying multiple  Heat status effects, such as via Multishot or  Archon Vitality in a single hit will not generate multiple stacks.
Stacking the  Cascadia Flare buff does not require the  Heat proc to come from the attached secondary weapon, and can stack even while the secondary is holstered. Sources include:
Any weapon with modded or innate  Heat damage and status chance
Warframes with abilities that directly inflict  Heat status effects, such as  Ember,  Nezha,  Protea,  Uriel,  Gauss, Wisp and  Temple
Warframes with  Heat-moddable Exalted Weapons, such as  Mesa,  Titania,  Jade,  Dante and  Hildryn, plus others
Warframes which have received subsume abilities from the Helminth that can inflict  Heat, including
 Jade Stars from  Sirius & Orion
 Thermal Sunder from  Gauss
 Fire Walker from  Nezha
 Fire Blast from  Ember
 Ophanim Eyes from  Jade
 Null Star from  Nova with the  Neutron Star augment
Warframes with abilities that apply many status effects, such as  Citrine,  Koumei and  Voruna
Warframes with variable-element configurations, such as  Lavos and  Chroma
Warframes that make  Heat-inflicting traps, such as  Follie and  Mirage
Performing a Bullet-Jump near enemies while  Firewalker is equipped
Companion Weapons that deal  Heat elemental damage via mods like  Burning Claws and  Flame Gland
Despite inflicting  Heat,  Focused Prospectus does not stack Cascadia Flare.
Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as Bosses and Adversaries, applying a  Heat proc to an enemy at max procs will still cause Cascadia Flare to refresh and stack.
Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply  Heat.
Buff is treated similarly to damage mods like  Hornet Strike, and is additive with base damage mods.
If the 10 second timer expires without applying a fresh  Heat status effect, all stacks of Cascadia Flare are removed.
This behavior is consistent with other weapon arcanes that trigger on status effect application, like  Conjunction Voltage and  Primary Frostbite
Compared to those arcanes, which usually last for 12 seconds, Flare has the shortest duration at 10 seconds.
Cascadia Flare's buff expiration is distinct from weapon arcanes that trigger on kill, like  Secondary Merciless and  Secondary Deadhead, where expiration only causes one stack to be removed at a time.

Tips
With high fire rate weapons such as  Spectra, Cascadia Flare's max stack can be reached rather quickly despite its tendency to lose all its stacks upon expiry.
Equipping a sentinel with a high-status companion weapon such as Verglas — modded for viral and heat, fire rate and multishot — can effectively help keep the stacks of Cascadia Flare maxed.
Works well on secondaries with innate Heat damage and high status chance such as the  Atomos,  Hystrix ( Prime) with Heat Quills, and  Tenet Cycron, as long as Heat is included among the listed elemental damage and not its derivatives such as  Gas.
Also works very well with weapons that possess a base secondary elemental damage type and high status chance such as the  Synoid Gammacor and  Kompressa when combined with  Primed Heated Charge, as long as the added Heat is included as a damage type.
If a secondary Exalted Weapon is modded for  Heat, there is multi-point synergy from Cascadia Flare with  Arcane Hot Shot, and the  Topaz Archon Shard buff for secondary critical chance on  Heat kills.
This trifecta produces a combined 480% base damage bonus and up to a maximum 675% bonus critical chance for secondary weapons.
The Helminth-subsumable ability  Jade Stars launches motes capable of inflicting multiple  Heat procs per second in line with the player's attacks, making any frame capable of producing many  Heat procs
Because  Jade Stars produces so many procs so reliably, it can potentially stack and maintain the Flare buff without weapon procs, allowing for an elemental damage mix on the weapon that doesn't necessarily involve  Heat as a final element.

Bugs
If installed in the secondary arcane slot of an Archgun equipped in the Heavy Weapon slot (on the third page of the Arsenal screen, below Gear and Emotes wheels), applying  Heat status effects will cause the buff icon to appear even while that weapon is not equipped.
However, the effects are not applied to any weapon unless  Cascadia Flare is installed in that weapon's active arcane slot.
 Yareli cannot gain stacks from abilities while riding  Merulina, only  Heat status effects from weapons will count.
